title: Carry-Out Charge for Removed Equipment in Attached Dwellings, Homeowner Service Contracts
content:
A carry-out charge is added to the disposal charge for the haul-away of equipment Bridgewell replaced under a Homeowner Service Contract:

- **20.00** when the property is a townhome or condominium and the replacement request was an appliance-trade request;
- **12.00** when the property is a townhome or condominium and the request was for another trade (heating and cooling, plumbing, electrical or garage door);
- **nothing** when the property is a single-family or mobile home.

The property type is the one recorded on the contract; the trade is the one recorded on the replacement request.

| Property | Appliance trade | Any other trade |
|---|---|---|
| townhome | 20.00 | 12.00 |
| condominium | 20.00 | 12.00 |
| single-family home | nothing | nothing |
| mobile home | nothing | nothing |

*Hypothetical:* a condominium owner's water heater, a plumbing-trade request, carries a 12.00 carry-out charge.
